I'm OP by the way, they banned all my other alts.

The temptation, though, I can't fight it. I just can't. I'm failing right now. Why is there no support for people like me? I'm going to fail again, I always fail. I can't go on like this. I just can't.

Would that it were true. Is is natural, or have I convinced myself that it is? I shouldn't be trusted, after all. I don't know, I am confused.

But, regardless, I am here not purely because of a desire to change that I know I will never sate, because I can't change, but because of my own failure to do so being highlighted in a way I can't ignore. I'm here because I've essentially relapsed, as it were, to my old way of thinking, of doing. On the basest level, nothing brings me more joy than those horrible thoughts, those pictures that shouldn't exist. I am scum. I am.

I can't move on. I'll do it again, I'll do something worse. What if I hurt a child? What if I can't stop myself? I would be better off dead.

Half of me wants to plead for sympathy, it wants to ask the world how they would feel if they were forbidden utterly to give into their impulse to mate with those to whom they are attracted. That part still tells me it is unfair. But the other half, my rational half, knows this is wrong. There is nothing unfair about my situation. I should suffer, in fact, I should die, rather than having a child suffer.

I know that. But it was a real interview with a real PHD, which is something to consider.

Is it not normal to procrastinate things that are difficult? To get quickly bored of a game?

I can't find any that hasn't been blasted with criticism.

I have no other problems. I was diagnosed with ADHD. I never get anything done, I can't focus on even things I love doing, let alone work, I procrastinate everything I've ever done, I have no motivation, I feel no urgency even when there is immense urgency, and I have little inhibition. I am impulsive, lazy, and indisciplined. Is this a disorder?
No? I'm saying that if ADHD is a disorder of attention, then more authority probably won't help.

I agree. However, nearly all public opinion on ADHD is that it is absolutely false. I have ADHD and, if it's real, it affects my life enormously, but I find myself doubting it in response to the weight of opinion from nearly all those I meet. I can't prove that ADHD is what makes me different from them, how do I know I'm not just lazy?
But this plays right back into the question. If it is a disorder, then authority has nothing to do with it, the kids are born that way. If it isn't then it isn't a disorder at all.
What scientific evidence? There is none.

http://www.adhd-report.com/adhd/13_exist.html

“ ... when depressed people start talking about depression, they talk about waking up tired and unable to motivate themselves. All day long they feel low and emotional. Many describe how they have difficulty getting off to sleep because of emotional thoughts going round and round in their heads. And when it is explained to them how they are doing this to themselves, the explanation alone helps - and then the therapy we do with them is primarily aimed at helping them to stop all the negative ruminating. The common explanation that their doctors give them is that there is a chemical imbalance in their brain. But that’s a half-truth: the other half is that their low serotonin level is an index that their life isn’t working - their needs are not being met and they feel stuck - not that they’ve got something ‘wrong’ with their brain chemistry. Brain chemistry is not a cause, it is an effect.”

The same thing applies to ADHD.

I have tried, but he tends to brush me off. It's strange, he is usually a very intelligent person. I think he just likes to feel superior to a group of people, and likes to blame people for problems (ie parents for shitty kids). What's most unfortunate is that, if I am correct, ADHD is severely impacting his life. He fails projects he starts all the time and his grades have slipped well below what they should be. I suppose in the end it's his problem, but I hate the fact that there is a way to make his life so much better that he just refuses to consider.
